title: Technical diagrams / Large node — Side bar

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Side bar node

slide_intent: Let a node’s structure accommodate its text and icon needs, because the label must remain the primary carrier of meaning in a complex diagram.
strategic_value: A consistent side-bar variant can give IBM technical diagrams flexible content capacity without inventing unrelated containers.
demonstration: Two pale-blue large nodes show expanded containers for nesting, one with a person icon and one without. Each contains a white Child node below its label; each caption states that the side bar expands with the text.
practical_value: Use the side-bar large-node variant for longer labels and nested nodes, with or without an icon.

content_islands.name: Node-type selector
content_islands.spec: Show Side bar node selected between Outlined node and Color block node.

content_islands.name: Icon-bearing node
content_islands.spec: Place the icon-bearing large node on the left, with its expanded-for-nesting label, side-bar explanation and inset Child node.

content_islands.name: Text-only node
content_islands.spec: Place the icon-free large node on the right, repeating the expanded container, side-bar explanation and inset Child node.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying large-node text says larger containers serve longer names and descriptions where text carries the most meaning.
reference_purposes.Application: The paused specimen shows the side-bar treatment with and without an icon, with a nested Child node in each; its captions explicitly state that the side bar expands with the text.
